title: rpc.Server.getLedgerEntries drops the extXdr field, so the sponsor of an entry cannot be read

target.versions_affected: 17.4.0 and main 5243062f (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: parseRawLedgerEntries copies every field of a getLedgerEntries result except extXdr, and Api.RawLedgerEntryResult does not declare it, so getLedgerEntries, getLedgerEntry, getAccountEntry, getTrustline and getClaimableBalance give no way to see an entry's LedgerEntryExt and so its sponsoringId (CAP-33). No value is decoded wrongly (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: the parsed getLedgerEntries result carries the entry's LedgerEntryExt when the server sends extXdr
entries.observed: No corpus entry drives the RPC client. By hand on 17.4.0 with a stubbed response in the shape stellar-rpc builds for a sponsored account: the raw entry has key, xdr, extXdr and lastModifiedLedgerSeq; the parsed entry has lastModifiedLedgerSeq, key and val only.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's script on 17.4.0 (main 5243062f has the same code), with the HTTP client stubbed: parsed entry keys are lastModifiedLedgerSeq, key and val; extXdr, which holds the sponsor GCATS5YO…ZI55U, is dropped.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-rpc's getLedgerEntries returns extXdr, the base64 LedgerEntryExt of the entry, since v23.0.0; LedgerEntryExt v1 carries sponsoringId (CAP-33).

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on 17.4.0 before filing on 2026-11-19: the parsed entry has no extension.

queries: stellar/js-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/issues/1913; this record restates the public issue.
